content.text: In regions where payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal fail to operate effectively, digital creators face significant hurdles in establishing online stores. Countries such as Nigeria and Zimbabwe experience financial isolation, making it essential to build robust, sovereign [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-4|COREMERCH guide to infrastructure]]. Supabase offers a reliable order database solution, enabling creators to deploy digital stores that accept crypto payments seamlessly. This guide will provide you with [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-automated-ebook-delivery-11|Everything You]]-you-need-know-about-bitcoin-payments-digital-16|everything]] you need to set your store live without relying on conventional payment services.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment platforms are often inaccessible in various regions, leaving creators without viable avenues to monetize their digital products. COREMERCH's infrastructure circumvents these issues by utilizing free tools like GitHub Pages and Supabase, allowing you to own your entire stack. By building on decentralized technologies, you ensure that your store remains operational, regardless of the volatility surrounding traditional financial systems. This approach provides you with full control over your data and payment processes, creating a resilient digital commerce solution tailored to your needs.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can launch your digital store, it's crucial to gather the necessary components. For Stack 01, you will need a GitHub account for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend logic, and an account with NOWPayments for processing crypto payments. Additionally, familiarize yourself with Supabase's capabilities as an order database, which will handle your transactions and customer data. This preparation ensures that you have all the tools at your disposal to deploy your store efficiently and effectively, setting the stage for a successful launch.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To establish a seamless payment and delivery pipeline, begin by setting up your NOWPayments account and integrating it with your GitHub-hosted store. Configure your Google Apps Script to handle payment confirmations and product deliveries, ensuring that customers receive their purchases automatically. Next, set up Supabase as your order database, enabling you to store transaction records and manage inventory efficiently. This structured approach ensures that your digital store operates smoothly, providing customers with a frictionless purchasing experience while you retain full ownership of your data.
Own your infrastructure; don't rent it.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you've set up your payment and delivery pipeline, it's time to go live. Deploy your GitHub Pages site and run tests to ensure that everything functions as expected. Monitor your NOWPayments integration closely to verify that it processes transactions correctly. After ensuring that your payment system is operational, promote your store through social media and other channels. This will drive traffic to your site, allowing you to process your first transaction smoothly and providing a foundation for future sales.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your digital store up and running, focus on scaling your operations. Consider enhancing your product offerings by adding more digital goods while utilizing Supabase's efficient database management features. Implement marketing strategies to expand your reach and attract more customers. As your business grows, leverage the Edge Commerce Stack, which provides additional capabilities such as enhanced security configurations and increased product limits. This proactive approach will ensure that your store remains competitive and continues to thrive in a challenging digital landscape.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, deploy Stack 01 or Stack 02 from COREMERCH. Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages, Google Apps Script, and NOWPayments, allowing you to have a fully operational store quickly. Stack 02 offers more features and is deployed within 48 hours, making it a robust choice for serious creators.
Seamless crypto payments without KYC.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

The setup decision comes down to time versus depth. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything to build Stack 01 yourself in an afternoon or Stack 02 over a weekend — full source code, step-by-step configuration, and the NOWPayments integration guide. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH build Stack 02 for you in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configured for email deliverability. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. Both are at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Read the Sovereign Blueprint before you start configuring anything — understanding the complete architecture before touching any settings prevents the most common configuration mistakes. Create all required accounts first: NOWPayments, Cloudflare or GitHub, Supabase or Google account, Resend or Gmail. Then configure the backend with all credentials before deploying it. Then deploy the backend and confirm the endpoint is live. Then configure NOWPayments with the endpoint URL. Then build and deploy the storefront. Then configure your custom domain if using one. Then run the mainnet test. Then check the order database. Then — and only then — share the URL. The sequence is not arbitrary. Each step depends on the previous one.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a free digital store accepting crypto payments, utilize Stack 01 by deploying GitHub Pages, Google Apps Script, and NOWPayments together. This combination allows you to set up a fully functional online store within hours.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 is a basic deployment using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, taking 4-6 hours. Stack 02, however, offers a more robust infrastructure with Cloudflare Pages and Supabase, deployed in 48 hours and fully tested prior to handoff.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?
Yes, you can host your digital product store on either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Both platforms provide reliable hosting for your store, allowing integration with crypto payment solutions.
What are the benefits of using Supabase as my order database?

Supabase offers a powerful, scalable database solution that allows you to manage customer orders and transaction records efficiently. Its seamless integration with your payment processing makes it an ideal choice for digital stores.
How do I ensure my digital store is secure?

To ensure your digital store's security, implement SPF, DKIM, and DMARC protocols. Use secure payment methods like NOWPayments and regularly update your software stack to protect against vulnerabilities.
